rationale: With Justice Sotomayor assigning in a 5–4, she is most likely to keep the opinion to control scope and respond to the Babcock/fiscal-exposure dissent, though Justice Kagan is a close alternative for a tight textual holding on the “presented under this section” trigger. A Roberts principal dissent is the modal outcome, with a meaningful chance of a Kavanaugh separate dissent emphasizing harmonization and institutional/fiscal concerns.
